subject.title: feat(browser): side panel copilot with per-tab agent sessions

question: Should the bundled Chrome extension become an operator chat client with persistent per-tab sessions, and if so must origin enrollment and credential storage be redesigned before merge?
rationale: The implementation is functional and well-proven, but repository policy does not resolve whether the transport-focused bundled extension should own a full chat surface or require users to modify a security-sensitive allowlist manually.

options.title: Sponsor with safer setup
options.body: Approve the bundled side panel, but require an append-safe guided origin-enrollment flow and explicit approval of the stored operator-credential model before merge.

options.title: Accept the documented setup
options.body: Approve the current manual allowlist merge and persistent credential design as an intentional advanced-user contract.

options.title: Keep the extension transport-only
options.body: Decline the bundled chat surface and move tab-focused conversation work to a separately owned UI or plugin design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor with safer setup
recommendation.body: Approve the bundled side panel, but require an append-safe guided origin-enrollment flow and explicit approval of the stored operator-credential model before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current browser-extension architecture and consent model entered main through their merged work, so they are the strongest available owner for whether this UI belongs on that surface.
